name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.9-beta “Paris” (build 24) — the Windows release now carries the same version as the Mac app; both read the same matters, bundles, Word documents and licences.
• Bug-fix run: the duplicate badge and ✦ marker render as proper icons; printing survives a missing printer or a damaged image; the Date column sorts by date; the Duplicates window no longer re-lists exhibits you just trashed or merged; a second launch with a file or matter no longer blocks while a dialog is open; e-signature timeouts are reported instead of crashing.
• New app icon and the Mac-style launch screen.
• Word add-in: after an app update the LitArbi template in Word’s Startup folder is rebuilt automatically (while Word is closed), so the add-in always matches the app — this build brings the award citation template and the 12-column exhibit data to Word.
• Everything from 0.9.0: awards & decisions in the Jus Mundi style, duplicates, Merge Exhibits with undo, Translation & AI Protocol, Smart Lists and Languages, search scope, printing, Rename / Find & Replace, Recent Matters, file association.
